annotations.exact_quote: As a variant of nonnegative matrix factorization (NMF), symmetric NMF (SNMF) has shown to be effective for capturing the cluster structure embedded in the graph representation.
annotations.reason_zh: 摘要明确以对称非负矩阵分解（SNMF）作为NMF变体，是论文方法核心。

annotations.exact_quote: PCPSNMF is capable of learning the similarity and assignment matrices adaptively and simultaneously
annotations.reason_zh: 方法自适应学习样本相似度矩阵，即学习/修正样本间亲和关系，符合图结构学习。

annotations.exact_quote: we propose a novel SNMF-based semisupervised clustering method, namely, pairwise constraint propagation-induced SNMF (PCPSNMF).
annotations.reason_zh: 摘要方法名直接表明由成对约束传播诱导，属扩展成对监督关系的成对约束传播。

annotations.exact_quote: we propose a novel SNMF-based semisupervised clustering method
